title: Exclude positive BIT rechart gains on 372 named three-component supports
body:
Releasing one movable exterior neighbor of each of the 50 formerly apparent positive #7881 pairs yields 372 deduplicated supports. At each of the three tested κ points, 38,860 exterior-feasible assignments contain 37,990 losses, 372 ties and 498 optimistic positives. All 498 fail exact geometry. The independent modular checker derives 440 lower-rank, 34 normal-rank and 24 nonorthogonality witnesses and recounts their full 36-call bills.

Uses #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #7881 at c2d6b3bae2e0b0fed3dd24b3166e3df1b833249c. The cold global and modular verifiers passed with named and even-shard controls. Both exact source orientations passed. OpenAI Codex assisted. Retained authors credited.
